title: Neko Kingdom SMP
description: A Server for Boys, Girls, and everyone in between.
body:
# Welcome to Neko Kingdom!

Hello! Were a Minecraft server that focuses on diversity and community.

Were an 18+ server with a focus on light roleplay, collaboration and community events for everyone to participate in.



We also have a role system where you can eventually form your own kingdom!



We have plenty of plugins to enhance your experience:

## Voicechat

We support the use of proximity voice chat so that your neighbors aren't just names on a screen but people you know

## Graves
Whenever you die a grave will be created that only you can open that lasts 24 hours.

## Emotecraft

We support the use of emotecraft so you can further express yourself with your fellow players.﻿

## Nexo And MythicMobs

Enjoy custom items and abilities added with these robust plugins﻿

## GSit

Enjoy the freedom to sit, crawl, and more at the drop of a command!

## HeadsPlus

All vanilla mobs now have a chance to drop their head, collect them all or complete challenges!

## EvenMoreFish

Dive into our custom fish plugin and try and collect them all!

## CoreProtect

The Premiere grief prevention plugin, any action a bad actor takes can be rolled back by an admin.
